name: UK weather warnings
summary: Met Office yellow ice warnings for northern and central England on 27 Nov; no amber or red warning
state: The Met Office had yellow warnings of ice in force on 27 Nov for the East Midlands, West Midlands, North East, North West and Yorkshire & Humber (Met Office). Ice warnings are routine for late November, and with no amber or red warning the level stays Normal under hysteresis.
for_you: Follow Met Office advice on icy roads and pavements; allow extra time for travel in affected areas.
rubric_hit: Yellow ice warnings only; no amber or red
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
